notes: Measuring your foot is more accurate: the scan reads the depth of the floor under your foot instead of the area behind it, and no longer lets a blurry frame or a still-settling floor skew the length
The guide box follows your foot now — set it down anywhere in view, instead of sliding it into one fixed spot
The scan captures the top view only, so one foot or both match what the camera sees
Based on your size follows the scale your scan set — men's, women's or kids' — instead of every product that happens to match the number
The See more card on that shelf appears only when the shelf actually holds more than the ten products already on screen
The 3D shoe viewer now has a Lighting control: brighten a shoe that reads too dark, or turn the shadow off if you want it flatter
The viewer now says plainly that the shoe you turn is the compressed model, while the photos on the page are the originals
The team's admin portal can look at a product's 3D models — drafts and rejected versions included — before closing a fitting request
